tools.name: tally_get_capabilities
tools.description: Discover enabled operations, limits and required scopes. Amounts are integer minor units; currencies are separate.

tools.name: tally_get_service_status
tools.description: Read service and storage readiness without secrets.

tools.name: tally_list_ledgers
tools.description: List ledgers authorized for this actor.

tools.name: tally_get_ledger
tools.description: Read a ledger revision and metadata, without transaction descriptions.

tools.name: tally_list_months
tools.description: List months containing transactions or settings.

tools.name: tally_list_categories
tools.description: Read built-in and custom categories, including archived categories when requested.

tools.name: tally_create_category
tools.description: Create a unique income or expense category in this currency ledger.

tools.name: tally_update_category
tools.description: Rename a category and atomically update transaction and budget references.

tools.name: tally_archive_category
tools.description: Archive a category while preserving historical entries and budgets.

tools.name: tally_restore_category
tools.description: Make an archived category available for new entries again.

tools.name: tally_get_preferences
tools.description: Read the owner's display currency preference.

tools.name: tally_update_preferences
tools.description: Set the display currency without moving money between ledgers.

tools.name: tally_list_transactions
tools.description: Read at most 100 entries. Cursors are bound to a query and revision; refresh after stale_cursor.

tools.name: tally_get_transaction
tools.description: Read one transaction by opaque id.

tools.name: tally_create_transaction
tools.description: Create a transaction using a durable idempotency key and expected ledger revision.

tools.name: tally_update_transaction
tools.description: Patch a transaction; amounts are positive integer minor units.

tools.name: tally_prepare_delete_transaction
tools.description: Freeze a delete preview; inspect it before committing.

tools.name: tally_delete_transaction
tools.description: Commit the exact frozen delete preview. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_prepare_batch_changes
tools.description: Preview at most 100 atomic transaction changes.

tools.name: tally_commit_batch_changes
tools.description: Commit the exact reviewed batch atomically. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_get_month_settings
tools.description: Read a month's savings goal and category budgets.

tools.name: tally_get_savings_goal
tools.description: Read a month's savings goal.

tools.name: tally_set_savings_goal
tools.description: Set a positive monthly goal target and a name of at most 40 characters.

tools.name: tally_get_category_budget
tools.description: Read a category limit; null means no limit.

tools.name: tally_set_category_budget
tools.description: Set a positive category budget.

tools.name: tally_clear_category_budget
tools.description: Remove a category limit. Zero is not a valid budget.

tools.name: tally_get_month_summary
tools.description: Calculate deterministic monthly totals; does not call an AI provider.

tools.name: tally_get_category_totals
tools.description: Calculate monthly totals by expense category.

tools.name: tally_get_budget_status
tools.description: Calculate budget and savings progress.

tools.name: tally_stage_statement
tools.description: Stage a legacy budget-only CSV or text PDF; no account balance, counterpart matching or reconciliation effects. Upload via the private file endpoint; never pass a server path or URL.

tools.name: tally_get_import
tools.description: Read paginated staged statement rows for correction; no ledger changes.

tools.name: tally_set_import_mapping
tools.description: Set explicit column and date mappings; invalidate prior previews.

tools.name: tally_correct_import_rows
tools.description: Correct up to 100 source rows, then preview again. Currency cells still undergo validation.

tools.name: tally_preview_import
tools.description: Freeze an import preview; invalid rows block commit, duplicates are excluded.

tools.name: tally_commit_import
tools.description: Commit the exact reviewed import once; duplicates remain excluded. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_cancel_import
tools.description: Cancel a draft; committed entries are not reversed.

tools.name: tally_export_transactions_csv
tools.description: Create an expiring private CSV download handle.

tools.name: tally_export_monthly_pdf
tools.description: Create a Tally-branded monthly PDF from the canonical ledger.

tools.name: tally_export_backup
tools.description: Create a versioned JSON ledger backup, keeping its currency explicit.

tools.name: tally_get_file
tools.description: Read metadata and private download path for an owned file handle, never arbitrary filesystem paths.

tools.name: tally_preview_restore
tools.description: Validate an uploaded backup and freeze replacement of this currency only. Current data is preserved in a private backup at commit.

tools.name: tally_commit_restore
tools.description: Commit the exact frozen restore; preserve the other ledger. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_get_recovery_status
tools.description: Read whether uploaded recovery material is available. Browser-local data must be explicitly uploaded.

tools.name: tally_export_raw_recovery
tools.description: Copy an owned uploaded raw recovery file into a short-lived download handle.

tools.name: tally_verify_ledger_integrity
tools.description: Validate stored transaction dates, categories, ids and amounts.

tools.name: tally_prepare_clear_month
tools.description: Freeze deletion of all entries in one month.

tools.name: tally_clear_month
tools.description: Clear only entries in the reviewed month preview. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_prepare_remove_sample_entries
tools.description: Freeze removal of entries explicitly marked as samples.

tools.name: tally_remove_sample_entries
tools.description: Remove the reviewed sample entries only. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_get_ai_status
tools.description: Read optional provider readiness and spending limits, without configuration secrets.

tools.name: tally_create_analysis_context
tools.description: Freeze aggregate monthly context for external-provider consent. No descriptions or custom goal names are included.

tools.name: tally_ask_spending_question
tools.description: Start one bounded provider request using a trusted consent approval. Requires configured provider; never retries automatically.

tools.name: tally_get_ai_request
tools.description: Read a provider request result or interrupted state.

tools.name: tally_cancel_ai_request
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight provider call; a completed request remains completed.

tools.name: tally_request_approval
tools.description: Request trusted owner approval for an existing preview. This operation never grants approval.

tools.name: tally_get_approval
tools.description: Read approval status for your own operation.

tools.name: tally_get_operation
tools.description: Read your operation/preview, or its durable commit receipt.

tools.name: tally_cancel_operation
tools.description: Cancel an uncommitted preview. A committed receipt is returned unchanged.

tools.name: tally_list_audit_events
tools.description: Read paginated audit metadata for this currency; does not disclose transaction descriptions.

tools.name: tally_get_operation_receipt
tools.description: Read the immutable receipt of your committed operation after a disconnect.

tools.name: tally_prepare_undo
tools.description: Preview a compensating operation, allowed only when the ledger still matches the committed after-state.

tools.name: tally_commit_undo
tools.description: Commit a reviewed compensating operation; original audit events remain intact. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_list_accounts
tools.description: List bank, cash, card and loan accounts. Legacy budget entries are separate.

tools.name: tally_get_account
tools.description: Read account metadata and reviewed opening cutoff.

tools.name: tally_prepare_account
tools.description: Prepare an account and optional reviewed opening balance; no postings until reviewed commit.

tools.name: tally_prepare_opening_balance
tools.description: Prepare the first opening; overlapping historical movements require migration review.

tools.name: tally_prepare_account_update
tools.description: Prepare account rename/archive/restore; type/currency and history stay immutable.

tools.name: tally_prepare_opening_correction
tools.description: Prepare an explicit signed opening correction with a reason; never infer a plug from a closing-balance discrepancy.

tools.name: tally_commit_account_change
tools.description: Commit a reviewed account/opening change atomically with receipt and audit. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_prepare_journal_event
tools.description: Prepare balanced income, purchases, transfer/ATM, card settlement, loan principal/interest or refund; category allocations are separate from accounts.

tools.name: tally_prepare_journal_reversal
tools.description: Prepare compensating postings; never delete or silently rewrite a posted journal.

tools.name: tally_commit_journal_event
tools.description: Commit the exact reviewed journal once; principal/transfers are not extra income or spending. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_list_journal_events
tools.description: Read paginated account journals, separate from unassigned legacy transactions.

tools.name: tally_get_journal_event
tools.description: Read a posted event and all balanced postings.

tools.name: tally_get_account_balance
tools.description: Read recorded balance at a date; unknown opening means null, not zero. Dated statement metadata is included when Phase B is enabled.

tools.name: tally_get_financial_position
tools.description: Read scoped assets/liabilities; net position is unknown when openings are missing. No live bank data.

tools.name: tally_get_cash_flow
tools.description: Calculate dated bank/cash movement; transfers cancel in aggregate and openings are excluded.

tools.name: tally_get_income_expense_report
tools.description: Calculate dated journal income and net expense; legacy entries remain excluded until reviewed migration.

tools.name: tally_export_accounting_backup
tools.description: Export account metadata and immutable journals; does not restore or migrate legacy budget entries.

tools.name: tally_stage_account_statement
tools.description: Retain selected CSV/text-PDF bytes and account/period metadata privately; stage only, no financial posting.

tools.name: tally_revise_account_statement
tools.description: Append an immutable mapping/correction revision. Original bytes and rows remain; linked source rows cannot be rewritten.

tools.name: tally_list_account_statements
tools.description: Read persistent latest statement revisions; currency and account scoped.

tools.name: tally_get_account_statement
tools.description: Read statement metadata, paginated original cells before mapping, or mapped source observations with reviewed decisions.

tools.name: tally_get_statement_source
tools.description: Create a private expiring download for retained immutable source bytes.

tools.name: tally_get_statement_matches
tools.description: Suggest provider/date/amount matches; similarities never merge or discard rows automatically.

tools.name: tally_prepare_statement_changes
tools.description: Freeze explicit source classification/link/exclusion decisions and balanced events; select all rows of chosen statements. Multiple account counterparts share one journal.

tools.name: tally_commit_statement_changes
tools.description: Commit the exact reviewed statement/source/journal diff with revision, receipt and audit. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_prepare_statement_reconciliation
tools.description: Freeze observed-versus-recorded closing and unresolved reasons; never creates a balancing plug.

tools.name: tally_commit_statement_reconciliation
tools.description: Record the reviewed reconciliation snapshot; discrepancies remain visible and are recomputed on later reads. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.

tools.name: tally_get_statement_coverage
tools.description: Read missing periods, overlaps, current reconciliation and saved history for an explicit account/date scope.

tools.name: tally_stage_legacy_migration
tools.description: Snapshot shared legacy entries or an explicitly uploaded backup without posting; preserve originals/settings and keep unassigned evidence separate.

tools.name: tally_get_legacy_migration
tools.description: Read original staged legacy entries/settings and decisions, including cutoff-excluded and unassigned history.

tools.name: tally_list_legacy_migrations
tools.description: Read staged legacy migration metadata without silently migrating browser data.

tools.name: tally_prepare_legacy_migration
tools.description: Freeze per-entry convert/cutoff/unassigned decisions; openings are explicit, dates and integer components must match. Shared converted entries leave legacy totals atomically.

tools.name: tally_commit_legacy_migration
tools.description: Commit reviewed legacy conversion once, retaining snapshot/decisions and settings with journal/receipt/audit. When the preview returns approvalRequired=false, send planId, previewHash and expectedRevision directly; otherwise include an owner-approved approvalId.
